why: The job asks for tenders and statements of work. Your CV says you coordinate vendors.
claimText: Ran vendor selection and contract follow-up for core banking integrations, from tender to statement of work.
interviewNarrative: At BRED I worked with our integration vendors every day. I took part in choosing them and checked their work against the contract.
lineOut: Coordinate third-party vendors on core banking and card-service integrations.

why: The job asks for business cases. Your CV shows reporting to leadership, but no business case.
interviewNarrative: I wrote the cost and benefit part of the case for my projects and presented it to the department heads.

why: The job names six teams. Your CV names business and IT teams.
claimText: Coordinated business, IT, operations, risk, compliance and finance teams on cross-border banking change.
interviewNarrative: Every change at BRED went through compliance and risk. Finance signed off the budget, and operations ran the rollout in each country.
lineOut: Senior Project Manager with 9+ years delivering banking technology in regulated environments.
